issue.reference_too_long: Reference answer is too long (max 4000 characters)

editor.description: For choice questions, click the letters of the correct options; for open questions, give a reference answer and scoring points. Write formulas as LaTeX between $…$.

editor.finalHint: A number or expression. When grading, the program first checks whether the student’s final answer is equivalent to it.
editor.rubricHint: They must add up to the question’s points. Without them the answer is graded as a whole against the reference answer; a calculation with only a final answer is scored on that answer.
editor.rubricPlaceholder: Point {{n}}: e.g. “states the derivative rule correctly”
editor.finalPoints: Points for a correct final answer (checked by the program)
editor.openDraftHint: An open question without a reference answer or scoring points is saved as a draft for self-checking and cannot be marked as checked.
editor.openVerifiedHint: Tick this when you have checked the reference answer and scoring points. Unchecked questions stay out of papers by default.

papers.empty: No papers yet. Build one in “Build a paper”.
papers.deleteText: “{{title}}” and all its attempts will be deleted. Learning records already made stay until you clear them in Memory.

attempt.updatedElsewhere: These answers were changed on another device or tab; the newest ones are shown.
attempt.submittedElsewhere: This paper was already submitted; that result is shown.
attempt.conflictBeforeSubmit: Newer answers were saved elsewhere and are now shown. Check them, then submit again.
attempt.confirmUnanswered: {{count}} questions are unanswered (No. {{numbers}}). Answers cannot be changed after submitting.
attempt.confirmAll: All questions are answered. Answers cannot be changed after submitting.
attempt.openNotice: Open questions are graded by AI against their scoring points after you submit; a calculation’s final answer is checked by the program first. Results are for reference.
attempt.tooLong: The answers are too long to save. Please shorten them.

report.gradedBy: Graded on the server against the paper's saved answers; no AI model was used.
report.partial: {{count}} open question(s) could not be graded. You can retry below each one.
report.gradingOff: Grading of open questions is paused: {{count}} answer(s) are saved and will be graded once it is back.

gradingError.STUDY_GRADING_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The selected model is not available. Check your model settings and try again.
gradingError.STUDY_GRADING_LIMIT: No more reviews are available for this question.
gradingError.STUDY_GRADING_BUSY: This question is still being graded. Try again shortly.
gradingError.capacity: Grading is busy right now. Please try again shortly.

report.gradedByMixed: Choice questions were graded on the server against the stored answers; open questions were graded with AI assistance against their scoring points (a calculation’s final answer is checked by the program first). For reference only.
report.reviewing: Grading again; the earlier result stays below…
report.reviewFailed: The new grading failed ({{reason}}); the earlier result still stands.
report.gradingFailed: Grading failed ({{reason}}); no score was given.

failure.invalid_output: the model’s output was not valid

report.selfGrade: Grading looks wrong? Score it yourself
report.selfHint: Your own score is shown separately and never replaces the graded score.

practice.figureMissing: Figure unavailable (the material may have been deleted)

publicSource.toggle: These questions come from a public resource
publicSource.hint: Record the link, date, version, licence and attribution. Being publicly reachable does not mean free to reuse; if unsure, the questions are marked “licence to be confirmed”.
publicSource.title: Resource name
publicSource.licenseClear: I have checked the licence allows this use
publicSource.licenseHint: Unticked, the questions are marked “licence to be confirmed” and stay for your own practice.

guide.none: No reference answer or scoring points.

extraction.dialogDescription: Reads the parsed text of a material in this subject, finds numbered questions, options and answers; you check each one before adding it to the bank.
extraction.noMaterials: This subject has no materials yet. Add one on the subject page and let it finish parsing.
extraction.notParsed: This version has not been parsed yet; extraction needs the parsed text.
extraction.rangeInvalid: Invalid page range: {{count}} pages, at most {{max}} per extraction.
extraction.rulesHint: Rule-based: no AI model and no OCR. Only the parsed text is read; pages without text (scans) are skipped and listed.
extraction.limit: This subject has reached {{max}} extractions; delete older ones first.
extraction.stats: {{pages}} pages read · {{found}} questions ({{choice}} choice, {{open}} other) · {{answers}} with a printed answer · rules took {{ms}} ms
extraction.usage: model help {{calls}} calls · {{input}} in / {{output}} out tokens · {{model}}
extraction.sourceGone: The material was deleted or removed from this subject; candidates can no longer be added to the bank.
extraction.oldVersion: Extracted from an older version (version {{n}}); questions point at that version.
extraction.skipped: Page(s) {{pages}} have no text (probably scanned) and were not extracted. Upload a text PDF or enter those questions by hand.
extraction.unassignedFigures: {{count}} figure(s) on page(s) {{pages}} belong to no question; select a question and add them on the left.
extraction.truncated: Too many questions: only the first 500 were kept. Use smaller page ranges.
extraction.empty: No numbered questions were found. Exercises need numbers such as “1.”, “第 1 题” or “例 1”; you can also enter them by hand.
extraction.originalUnavailable: The original cannot be shown right now.
extraction.pageNoText: No text was parsed on this page.
extraction.sourceLines: Source of no. {{label}} (file page {{pages}}). Use the scissors to start a new question at a line.
extraction.assistHint: Optional: your selected model tidies the chosen questions (formulas as LaTeX) and suggests answers, up to {{max}} at a time. Suggestions change nothing until adopted and never count as checked.
extraction.commitHint: Only choice questions can be added (open questions come later). Without “answer checked” they are added as unverified; questions without an answer become drafts.

errors.conflict: This question changed elsewhere; showing the latest.
errors.model: No model is available; choose and configure one in settings.
errors.assistLimit: The model-help budget of this extraction is used up.
errors.assistInvalid: The model’s answer could not be used; try again.
errors.busy: Too many tasks right now; try again shortly.

extraction.committed: Added {{created}} ({{duplicates}} already in the bank, {{invalid}} could not be added).
extraction.assisted: The model suggested {{count}} question(s) ({{missing}} without a result). Check before adopting.
extraction.deleteText: Its candidates are deleted; questions already added to the bank stay.
extraction.openHint: Open questions go into the bank with their printed answer as the reference answer; those without one are saved as drafts. Edit to set the type, final answer and scoring points.
extraction.suggestion: Model suggestion ({{model}}, unverified; applies only if adopted)
extraction.noSuggestedAnswer: The model was not sure and gave no answer.
extraction.openSuggestion: Open question: formatting only, no answer.
